title: Set Rule sets every range of every checked side and leaves the rest
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, used by two new categories made for this test, three ranges, tier A on Same as previous tier.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, Inactive, with Separate Part Sale pricing on, tier A on its own rule 5% off on both sides.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix C, tier A on 7% off.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Check matrix B.
  5. Type 20 in the bar's value.
  6. Click Set Rule.
  7. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  8. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  9. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  10. Open matrix B's page from the Matrices list.
  11. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The count is 1.

Step 4:

  • The count is 2.

Step 5:

  • The value reads 20 with % Off.

Step 6:

  • The question says 2 matrices (1 inactive).

Step 7:

  • No Change Prices question appears, though matrix A prices two categories.
  • The checks clear.
  • Matrix C's row still reads 7% off.

Step 8:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 9:

  • Tier A's column in matrix A reads 20% off in all three ranges.

Step 10:

  • Inactive matrix B's Work Order Matrix shows tier A at 20% off.

Step 11:

  • Matrix B's Part Sale grid also shows tier A at 20% off, replacing 5% off.
